title: coated wire baskets
text: coated wire baskets. I purchased these to help me organize my upright freezer.  They are just what I needed.  No more stuff lost in the back or fighting the one handed grab to catch what is falling to the ground.  I can put things in date order - pull from the front (like cheese packages) separate the meats... poultry ... seafood.  Where have these been all my life?
